# Amazon
> Amazon is a global ecommerce platform for shopping, digital content, devices, cloud services, and seller tools.

Amazon operates a broad ecosystem spanning retail, Prime membership, devices, entertainment, publishing, advertising, and developer platforms. This index highlights durable, high-signal resources across Amazon-owned properties that are useful for language models.

## Shopping & Customer Help
- [Amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com/): Main retail marketplace for products, deals, subscriptions, and customer account services.
- [Customer Service](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html): Central help hub for orders, returns, payments, devices, and account issues.
- [Returns Center](https://www.amazon.com/returns): Start, manage, and track product returns and refund requests.
- [Your Orders](https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/order-history): Order history page for tracking purchases, invoices, and returns.
- [Prime](https://www.amazon.com/amazonprime): Prime membership overview covering shipping, streaming, and member benefits.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.amazon.com/gift-cards/b/): Gift card storefront with balance, reload, and redemption information.

## Seller, Vendor & Marketplace
- [Sell on Amazon](https://sell.amazon.com/): Seller platform overview for listing products, fulfillment, and marketplace growth.
- [Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.com/): Operational portal for managing listings, inventory, orders, and advertising.
- [Seller Central Help](https://sellercentral.amazon.com/help): Documentation for seller workflows, policies, and account management.
- [Fulfillment by Amazon](https://sell.amazon.com/fulfillment-by-amazon): FBA program details for warehousing, shipping, and customer service.
- [Amazon Brand Registry](https://brandservices.amazon.com/): Brand protection and intellectual property tools for enrolled brands.
- [Vendor Central](https://vendorcentral.amazon.com/): Portal for first-party vendors supplying products directly to Amazon.

## Advertising & Marketing
- [Amazon Ads](https://advertising.amazon.com/): Advertising platform for sponsored products, display, video, and measurement tools.
- [Amazon Ads Help Center](https://advertising.amazon.com/resources): Guides, learning resources, and product information for advertisers.
- [Amazon DSP](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-dsp): Demand-side platform for programmatic display and video campaigns.
- [Sponsored Ads](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/sponsored-ads): Overview of sponsored product, brand, and display ad formats.
- [Amazon Attribution](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-attribution): Measurement tools for off-Amazon marketing impact on Amazon sales.

## AWS Documentation & APIs
- [AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/): Central documentation portal for AWS services, SDKs, and developer guides.
- [AWS API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/index.html): Entry point to service references, API operations, and technical documentation.
- [AWS SDKs and Tools](https://aws.amazon.com/tools/): Official SDKs, CLIs, and developer tooling for AWS integration.
- [AWS CLI Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/): Command line interface guides, command reference, and configuration details.
- [AWS Well-Architected](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/): Best practices for secure, reliable, efficient cloud architectures.
- [AWS Whitepapers & Guides](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/): Technical whitepapers, architecture guidance, and implementation patterns.

## AWS Learning & Architecture
- [AWS Architecture Center](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/): Reference architectures, diagrams, patterns, and solution guidance.
- [AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/): Implementation guidance for migrations, modernization, and operational patterns.
- [AWS Training and Certification](https://aws.amazon.com/training/): Learning paths, courses, exam prep, and certification resources.
- [AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/): Community knowledge base for AWS troubleshooting and technical questions.
- [AWS Blogs](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/): Product announcements, tutorials, and engineering updates across AWS services.

## Devices, Alexa & Smart Home
- [Amazon Devices](https://www.amazon.com/b?node=9818047011): Hub for Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, Ring, and other Amazon devices.
- [Alexa Skills Kit](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa): Developer platform for building Alexa skills and voice experiences.
- [Alexa Developer Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/): Technical docs for skill development, APIs, testing, and certification.
- [Appstore Developer Console](https://developer.amazon.com/apps-and-games): Resources for publishing apps and games to Amazon devices.
- [Fire TV Developer Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/fire-tv/): Guides and APIs for building and testing Fire TV applications.
- [Ring Help](https://support.ring.com/): Support articles for Ring setup, troubleshooting, subscriptions, and device management.

## Digital Content & Entertainment
- [Prime Video](https://www.primevideo.com/): Streaming service for movies, series, channels, rentals, and purchases.
- [Amazon Music](https://music.amazon.com/): Music streaming service with subscriptions, playlists, and podcasts.
- [Kindle Store](https://www.amazon.com/kindle-dbs/storefront): Ebook storefront for Kindle books, subscriptions, and reading apps.
- [Audible](https://www.audible.com/): Audiobook and spoken-word platform with memberships and digital purchases.
- [Amazon Games](https://www.amazongames.com/): Amazon gaming hub for titles, publishing, and related announcements.
- [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/): Live streaming platform for gaming, creators, and community broadcasts.

## Publishing & Authors
- [Kindle Direct Publishing](https://kdp.amazon.com/): Self-publishing platform for ebooks, paperbacks, and hardcover books.
- [KDP Help](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help): Documentation for publishing workflows, royalties, formatting, and policies.
- [Amazon Publishing](https://amazonpublishing.amazon.com/): Information about Amazon’s publishing imprints and submission pathways.
- [Author Central](https://author.amazon.com/): Author profile management for books, biographies, and reader engagement.
- [Amazon Ads for Authors](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/industries/books): Advertising solutions tailored to books and author marketing.

## Business, Payments & Programs
- [Amazon Business](https://www.amazon.com/business/register/org/landing): Business purchasing platform with multi-user accounts and procurement tools.
- [Amazon Pay](https://pay.amazon.com/): Payments platform for merchants using Amazon account-based checkout.
- [Amazon Associates](https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/): Affiliate program for earning commissions by linking to Amazon products.
- [Amazon Hub](https://www.amazon.com/b?node=17337376011): Package pickup and delivery solutions including lockers and counters.
- [Amazon Trade-In](https://www.amazon.com/l/9187220011): Trade-in program for eligible electronics and devices.
- [Amazon Reload](https://www.amazon.com/b?node=10232440011): Add funds to Amazon balance for purchases and gift card use.

## Corporate, Policy & News
- [About Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/): Corporate information, leadership, initiatives, and company news.
- [Amazon News](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news): Official newsroom for announcements, launches, and company updates.
- [Investor Relations](https://ir.aboutamazon.com/): Financial reports, SEC filings, governance, and shareholder information.
- [Amazon Sustainability](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet): Sustainability commitments, climate initiatives, and environmental reporting.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GX7NJQ4ZB8MHFRNJ): Amazon privacy practices, data handling, and user rights information.
- [Conditions of Use](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GLSBYFE9MGKKQXXM): Terms governing use of Amazon websites, services, and content.
